userFeedback.baseline: V061 was described by the user as basically OK; preserve its visual direction
nextPriorities: complete lightning and cyclone weather rules

priority: AAA visual-quality target and full workbench functionality take precedence over source size. The user permits several megabytes. Never sacrifice lighting or features to retain the retired 20 KB limit.
runtimeStorage: Seeded density, noise, optical-depth and conservatively dilated occupied-cell buffers generated in browser memory. No cloud photographs, image atlases, HDR photographs, imported cloud meshes or generated image assets.
loopScope: Material-space morphology closes periodically for a fixed seed and parameters. World-space wind translation, illumination, aircraft and precipitation have independent clocks. Do not claim the entire scene is a seamless video loop.
windConvention: Meteorological wind-from bearing. +X east and -Z north. 270 degrees transports toward +X; 0 degrees toward +Z. Wind and cloud speed are independent unless linkage is enabled.
lighting: Preserved linear HDR where available, optical-depth cache, near-light samples, multiple-scattering approximation, separate sun/sky/silver/ground components, continuous dawn/noon/dusk/night and final tone mapping. New lightning illuminates a local region and emits branched bolt radiance.
sampling: Preserved conservative group intervals and exact segment lengths; new occupied-cell mask safely rejects empty density queries without reducing resolution or ray steps. Micro detail is band-limited against sample footprint. Temporal history trust decreases with shape change and is rejected during lightning.
boundaryRule: Reject nonzero source density at the checked border. Occupancy expands the source support by detail-warp and interpolation margins. Sampling group margins expanded. No clipping merely to pass QA.
performanceMethod: Asynchronous disjoint GPU queries where supported and completed GPU-frame cadence. Same scene/seed/phase/quality interleaved A/B windows. SwiftShader comparison does not establish user GPU FPS or a general speed gain.
terrainInteraction: Analytical graphical updraft near demonstration hills; no real DEM modified.
aircraftInteraction: Preserved schematic aircraft and graphical local wake; no full aerodynamics.
precipitation: Graphical screen-space rain and snow, no hydrometeor simulation.
rainbow: Preserved primary/secondary antisolar angular approximation, no full spectral droplet solver.
lightning: Implemented graphical local events with branches and cloud illumination; no charge-separation solver.
tropicalCyclone: Eye, eyewall, spiral rainbands, outer cloud shield and upper outflow are rules only. No cyclone renderer or cyclone fluid simulation has been completed.
retiredCandidate: Never show rejected Cloud Mother V0.3.2 or the abandoned local V052 redesign as new work. Continue Weather Mother. Keep V061 intact while the V062 extension undergoes user visual review.
retainedHistory: V061 and V062 remain recoverable; no experimental versions in clean ZIP; unrelated production lines untouched.
